purpose: Resolve data/execution validity before selecting more profitable-looking hypotheses.

checks: zero-volume vs OHLC movement and txCount
common volume change point across pools
bounded independent swap/receipt evidence if accessible

required: price quote or fully specified historical liquidity model

performance_protocol.condition: Only new data with a documented coverage and quality check; executable conclusions additionally require execution gate.

new_archival_window_if_available.scope: fixed-rule historical transfer not temporal future OOS; previously unused performance window

performance_protocol.intraday_1m_5m_15m: Only if genuine observed complete history exists; otherwise unavailable, never upsample hourly data.
performance_protocol.long_horizon_365_730: Do not rerun prior seen windows as fresh OOS; require genuinely new valid input.
performance_protocol.statistical_probabilities: Not estimated if execution or sample gate fails; no unconditional future-probability claims.

software_plan: Preserve baseline 107 tests and archived outputs.
Write failing tests for historical evidence validation, gas conversion, zero-volume contradiction detection, and fresh fixed-rule signals.
Implement isolated standard-library evidence layer without wallet, signing, funding, or live-order endpoints.
Run forensic measurements and bounded read-only source probes; preserve failures and source hashes.
Run conditional fixed-rule experiments without tuning and classify unsupported fills separately from paper performance.
Publish equivalent EN/FA reports, updated status/work log, test evidence and PR to main after compatibility/CI checks.
stopping_rule: One bounded round. Continue only for demonstrably better data or a prespecified hypothesis. If execution cannot be supported, Reject executable-profit claims, retain diagnostic evidence, and keep real-capital decision NO-GO. No continuous paper service unless a candidate qualifies and an actual runtime is explicitly recorded.
privacy: No private financial information, personal identifiers or credentials in public artifacts.
